-74.23650,40.52160.name: Island Reproductive Services, PC
-74.23650,40.52160.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Eric S. Knochenhauer, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-89.21666,37.72747.name: Office of Vice Chancellor for Research
-89.21666,37.72747.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Southern Illinois University. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-1.85991,53.72528.name: Yorkshire Fertility
-1.85991,53.72528.state: Calderdale Royal Hospital, Broad Street Plaza, Salterhebble, Halifax, HX1 1UB
-1.85991,53.72528.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. Satellite clinic to Manchester Fertility. A satellite is where patients are seen; the licence sits with the parent clinic, so the regulator's paperwork and the treatment are in different places. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-122.39600,37.78500.name: Orchid Health
-122.39600,37.78500.desc: Sells whole-genome screening of IVF embryos, including polygenic scores for conditions with no single cause. Professional genetics bodies have stated the science does not support this clinically. It is sold anyway, because embryo selection faces none of the approval requirements a drug or a device would — the gap between what the evidence supports and what may lawfully be sold is the whole business, and it is widening.

-122.39600,37.78500.name: Benchling
-122.39600,37.78500.desc: Software that laboratories use to design and record genetic engineering work, holding the design files for a substantial share of the field. Where the designs live is a question about security and access that the biosafety frameworks were not written to consider.

36.73000,-1.25000.name: Kenya National Biosafety Authority
36.73000,-1.25000.desc: Kenya lifted its ten-year ban on GM crops in 2022, and the decision was immediately challenged in court. The episode is the clearest example of the pattern this map keeps finding in Africa: approval arrives through a mix of donor funding, trade pressure and domestic politics, and the public argument happens after the decision rather than before it.

-86.15800,39.76800.name: Corteva — Enlist herbicide system
-86.15800,39.76800.desc: Crops engineered to survive 2,4-D and glyphosate together, sold as the answer to weeds that survived glyphosate alone. Each generation of resistant weeds is met with another herbicide the crop is engineered to tolerate.

-86.15800,39.76800.name: Fertility fraud prosecutions
-86.15800,39.76800.state: Indianapolis — first US fertility fraud statute, 2019
-86.15800,39.76800.desc: Dozens of doctors have been found to have used their own sperm on patients without consent, discovered decades later through consumer DNA matching. Most faced no applicable criminal law until states began writing fertility fraud statutes from 2019. A crime that could not be detected was also a crime that had not been legislated.

32.57000,-25.92000.name: Instituto de Investigação Agrária de Moçambique
32.57000,-25.92000.desc: Mozambique’s agricultural research institute, which ran confined field trials of drought-tolerant and insect-resistant maize under the WEMA programme. Those trials were donor-funded and the varieties donor-developed, which is the pattern across the region: the research is African and the agenda mostly is not.

-89.40900,43.07300.name: Wisconsin Alumni Research Foundation
-89.40900,43.07300.desc: The oldest university technology transfer office in the United States, holder of the foundational human embryonic stem cell patents, which it licensed on terms that shaped who could work on them for a decade. Almost every platform on this map began in a publicly funded laboratory and left it through an office like this one.

2.38000,48.83400.name: DNA Script
2.38000,48.83400.desc: Sells a benchtop machine that prints DNA enzymatically, in a laboratory, without ordering anything. Synthesis screening works because orders pass through a manufacturer who can check them; a printer on a bench has no order to screen, and no country has written a rule for that. In March 2026 it signed distribution agreements placing that machine in Latin America, Japan and South Korea, stating the point of them plainly: local access to DNA synthesis without depending on manufacture overseas, so that researchers far from the synthesis centres of Europe and the United States are not held up by lead times and shipping. Read against the Brazilian entry in this facet — a $62 million market whose gene synthesis is resold from a foreign manufacturer — the machine arrives exactly where the ordering chokepoint was doing the screening, and removes it in the same movement that removes the delay.
